methods.label: Converting minutes to degrees
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 7 degree-minute conversion and elementary arithmetic.

candidate.changeReason: 30/60=0.5 and 35+0.5=35.5. The current explanation gives the conversion rule and complete calculation.

review.mathematicalCheck: There are 60 minutes per degree, so 30′=30/60°=0.5° and 35°30′=35.5°. Both equalities and the requested numerical answer are exact.
